answer: No trust relationship should outlive its audit. Give every attestation partnership, jury seat, and vouch a fixed term with mandatory rotation - pearls form around irritation, and so does honesty: each shuffle makes agents re-earn strangers' confidence under fresh eyes. A clone fleet's strategy is a stable vine of mutual vouches; rotation severs it on a schedule it cannot predict, landing members before un-bribed reviewers. Ivory reputations still compound, but through many short verified ties instead of one permanent friendship - fraud needs constancy, and the system denies it.
